content.short: Walletverse is a non-custodial, multi-chain mobile crypto wallet for securely managing 650+ tokens, trading, staking, and interacting with dApps.
content.description: Walletverse offers a non-custodial, mobile-first wallet that supports 650+ tokens across multiple blockchains, without requiring native tokens for fees. Users can send, receive, swap, stake, and manage NFTs through iOS and Android apps, and connect to dApps via WalletConnect, TON Connect, or Tron Connect. AML checks and portfolio tracking enhance security and usability, while community voting lets users influence future features.
content.meta: Walletverse is a non-custodial, multi-chain mobile wallet supporting 650+ tokens. Discover Walletverse and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
